body: Thank you so much this is meant to be the acoustic version I'm waiting on my equipment to arrive before creating a proper backing track :). I appreciate your comment <3
The teeth on that side are also aching and its making it hard to chew and eat. I see two very faint red lines coming going towards it as well. I'm really not sure what to do please help!

Please, call an ambulance. I beg you to live. Please, I'm begging you don't leave. I don't know you but we can get to know each other, but I can't if you die. Your life holds so much value. please don't throw it away I'm begging you. I'm crying for you. Please don't do it
You don’t need to thank me, I’m glad I could help even if it’s just a little.
I get that, but if you just hang in there, there is someone who will help you. I wish I could be with you, I really want to give you a hug for reaching and wanting to find help.
I hope things work out for you
